title: rhacoma
intro: Rhacoma, commonly known as Rhodiola rosea or Golden Root, is a perennial plant that belongs to the Crassulaceae family. Rhodiola is known to have several health benefits, including reducing stress, improving mental performance, and boosting the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Rhodiola include its adaptogenic properties, which help to balance the body's response to stress, and its ability to act as a nervous system tonic, which can help to alleviate anxiety and fatigue. The bioactive constituents of Rhodiola include rosavin, salidroside, and tyrosol, which are responsible for its adaptogenic and antioxidant properties.
